transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I just... I can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like... I'm a bad employee, and... a bad homeowner. It just feels like I deserve to lose what I've worked for. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while. I guess the... the depression, and just losing interest in things... it's been about two years. Maybe two years and a month.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to... I don't know, do things. Plan brunches, or... paint in the spare room. I used to go hiking, and... sign up for networking events. But now... I don't know. It just feels like a list of tasks. Like I'm just... pretending to care about them.
Have you experienced any periods where your depressive symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, it's just... it's just been pretty much like this. I haven't really noticed it being... worse. It's just kind of always there.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you didn't feel depressed?

Not really. I mean... looking back, the low mood and just... not caring about things... it's been there almost the whole time since this started. There were maybe... I don't know, a few brief periods where I could function a little better. But mostly... it's just been this.
Do you still experience pleasure when you do things, even if you don't feel like doing them?

No... not really. Like I said before... the brunches, the painting, hiking... it all just feels like work now. Even if I force myself to do it, it's just... going through the motions. There's no joy in it anymore.
Has anything significant happened in your life around the time when these feelings first started?

Um... well, it started about two years and three months ago. I guess... I had just bought a townhouse around then. Just... feeling the pressure of trying to keep up with it all, I suppose. That's when it began.
Have you had more than one episode of depression like this in your life?
Um... I don't think so. It's just... like I said, it feels like it's just been one long stretch since it started. I don't really remember it stopping.
Have you ever felt completely back to normal between episodes of depression?

No, not really... I mean, looking back, it's just... the low mood, the not caring about anything... it's basically been there the whole time. Since it started. Maybe... maybe there were a few short days where I could just... get through things a little easier, but... no, I haven't felt normal.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you didn't feel depressed?

Um... no. Not two months. Like I was saying... it's just been there pretty much the whole time. The low mood... not caring. Just... maybe a few days here and there where I could function a bit better. But... no long breaks like that.
Have you ever had a period of depression that lasted less than two years?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's just been this one long stretch. I guess... it's been about two years and a month now... of the low mood and just not caring about things.
Have you had an episode of depression like this before the one that started two years ago?
No... I don't think so. Just this one.
Have you had any periods of significant improvement in your depressive symptoms that lasted for several months before worsening again?

No. Like I said before... it's just been there pretty much the whole time. The low mood... the not caring. Just... maybe a few days here and there where I can function a little better. But... no, not several months. Just brief bits.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago that were separate and distinct from this current episode?

Um... no. I think I just said that. There wasn't anything before. Looking back, the low mood and... just not having any interest... it's been there almost the whole time since this all started two years ago. Just... those brief periods where I could function a little better. Nothing separate.
Have you had any periods of significant improvement in your depressive symptoms that lasted for at least two months before returning to your current state?

No... like I just said... it hasn't ever gotten better for that long. Just... looking back, the low mood and not caring about anything... it's been there almost the whole time since this started. Just those... brief periods where I could function a little better. Not two months.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months without any depressive symptoms since this started two years ago?

No... I feel like I'm just repeating myself. Looking back... the low mood and the loss of interest, it's been there almost the whole time since this started. I only get... brief periods where I can function a little better. Never two whole months.
Have you had any episodes of depression that completely resolved before this current episode started?

I... I don't really know how else to answer this. No. 

Like I've been saying... looking back on it, the low mood and the... loss of interest... it's just been there for almost the whole time since this started. I just get those... really brief periods where I can function a little better. Nothing before that.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago that completely went away on their own?

No... I haven't. I... I really don't know how many times I can say the same thing. 

Before two years ago, I was fine. But since this all started... looking back, the low mood and just... not caring about anything... it's been there almost the entire time. There hasn't been a time where it went away completely. Just... maybe a few days here and there where I could manage a bit better. That's it.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that completely went away?

I... I don't think I can explain it any differently. No. 

Like I keep saying... looking back, the low mood and the loss of interest... they've just been there for almost the whole time since this started. I only get these... brief periods where I can function a little better. That's all.
Have you had an episode of depression that completely resolved before this current episode started?

I... I really don't know what else to tell you. I've said it already. No. 

It's just... looking back at it all, the feeling low and just... not caring about anything... it's been there basically the whole time since this all began. I just get these really short stretches where things are a tiny bit easier to manage. But that's it. There wasn't anything before that.
